5 strategies were not released for holding positions too long for validation to judge. The strategy: wdi_extreme_only (trial 26), the accepted strategy with the best validation Sharpe; it was not released

Four fill models, each its own closed loop on the recorded book and trades: T fills only when a trade goes through the quote, RA joins the back of the displayed size and takes every cancel as behind it, PR takes cancels from ahead of it in proportion, and F is always at the front. Every number is in bps of one unit at the first mid of the segment. The judge scores the lower of RA's and PR's Sharpe in the score's column, each measured on blocks at least as long as that model's time-weighted mean hold, since one hold is one bet however many blocks it spans; the column before it is the same P&L on the brief's 5 min blocks.

On train the rule took RA: its Sharpe measures nothing (fewer than two of its blocks, or a P&L that never moved), and a pass with no number is the worse. On validation the rule took PR, the lower of PR's 0.4898 and RA's 0.6905. PR held its inventory 45 min 1 s on average, so validation holds 7 of its blocks, fewer than 20: the Ladder was given no score, and the strategy could not be released. T and F bracket the fill count, not the P&L: reality's fill count lies between T and F, and its P&L is not bounded by any row.

The half hour of the last segment with the most fills of the scored model: the touch, the quotes resting in it, each fill, and the inventory below.

After each fill: the mid's move in the fill's direction, weighted by units, for each model. A maker's fill sits below the mid at 0 by what it captured, and pays the fee; the line has to stay above the break-even for the fill to pay. Lines that fall after 0 are adverse selection.

How it dies. Adverse selection. You get filled most just before the price moves against you. Faster makers take the front of the queue, and a fee change can erase the margin.

# NOTES
- Bash: one `blinded submit` per command, no loops; use Write for files.
- Session 1 (speed): train rank IC @10s: weighted_depth_imbalance (5-level, weights 1,.5,.33,.25,.2) 0.20, released (val best 0.12);
  imbalance_build (ewm5-ewm100 of touch imbalance) 0.17, not released; flow_persist_30s (trade_imbalance 30s) ~0.01, useless.
- Book imbalance dominates; trade flow sign at 30s has ~no signal. Next: microprice-minus-mid in ticks with depth, imbalance x short-term trade flow (1s), trade flow with shorter windows (1-3s).
- Session 2 (market_making; file features/mm.py): micro_offset_bps (F.micro_minus_mid bps) train rIC@10s 0.21, RELEASED (best 0.14);
  toxic_flow (touch imbalance + 1s trade_imbalance) 0.14, not released (worse than pure imbalance); flow_vs_depth (3s signed vol/touch depth) 0.05, weak.
  Trade-flow adds nothing over book imbalance. Next: spread/quote-rate (activity) features, microprice with deeper levels, book-update-rate asymmetry.
- Session 3 (speed; features/s3.py, com.py, com2.py): panel level-0 prices are `SYM.bid`/`SYM.ask` (NOT bid_px); levels 1-4 are `bid{k}_px`. Use `blinded eval` locally to debug before submitting (errors cost a row).
  flow_persist_2s (trade_imbalance 2s) rIC@1s 0.08, @10s 0.05, not released. imbalance_innovation (imb - ewm100) 0.20@10s, not released.
  book_com_tilt (ask-side depth COM distance minus bid-side, bps) rIC@10s 0.17 (1s 0.25), not released; book_com_skew was its negation (wasted row).
  Everything is ~0.2 @10s and highly collinear with weighted_depth_imbalance; best 0.12 not beaten by margin. Next: nonlinear/state-conditional (imbalance when spread/vol low), trade-vs-book disagreement, 60s-horizon features.
- Session 4 (market_making; features/mm4.py): micro3_offset_bps (3-level microprice-mid) rIC@10s 0.19; micro_offset_calm (micro/ewm abs 1s-ret... vol scaling) 0.21 (identical to micro_offset: scaling is rank-neutral-ish);
  imbalance_busy (imb x quote_rate surge) 0.19 (@1s 0.29). None released (best 0.14). micro_offset_calm was redundant (wasted row).
  All book-skew variants saturate ~0.2 @10s; stop varying imbalance. Remaining: features that are NOT book skew (spread dynamics are constant 1 tick; try trade-size/kyle_lambda, funding, time-of-day, 60s horizon), or move on to strategies.
- Session 5 (speed; features/s5.py): deep_imbalance (levels 1-4 only) rIC@10s 0.095, @60s 0.074, not released (trial 17); trade_vwap_dev_1s (F.vwap_dev 1s) 0.02@10s, 0.06@1s, not released (18). imbalance_slow (30s mean imbalance) 0.05, not submitted.
  Speed edge looks exhausted for single features (best 0.12 vs ~0.2 train for copies, still not released: val is lower). Trade flow is weak everywhere. Move to strategies.
- Session 6 (market_making; features/mm6.py): touch order-flow imbalance (CKS OFI, depth-normalised) ofi_1s rIC@10s 0.18 (1s 0.19), ofi_5s 0.09@10s; trials 19-20, not released (best 0.14). OFI is the first non-skew signal but still below micro_offset. Remaining ideas thin; consider strategies (quote skew by micro_offset).
- Session 7 (speed; features/s7.py): extreme_imbalance (touch imbalance cubed) rIC@10s 0.21, not released (trial 21; best 0.12). absorption (imb x -3s trade imb) and flow_return_divergence (5s flow vs ret sign) were ~0 or negative on train, not submitted.
  Trade-flow features still ~0. Speed edge exhausted; recommend phase_done and move to strategies.
- Session 8 (market_making; features/mm8.py): micro_ofi_blend (z(micro)+z(ofi_1s)) rIC@10s 0.19, trial 22; micro_momentum (z(micro)+0.5 z(1s ret)) 0.19, trial 23; neither released (best 0.14). micro_delta (ewm3-ewm30 of micro) 0.17, not submitted.
  Blends/variants of micro offset never beat micro_offset itself (0.21). Feature space for market_making is exhausted; move to strategies (quote skew by micro_offset). Recommend phase_done.
- Session 9 (speed, STRATEGIES; strategies/s9.py): taker strategies lose to the 5 bps fee. Trials 24 wdi_extreme_threshold (wdi, z_in 3/z_out .5) SR -0.29, only 2 fills in train;
  25 micro_wide_hold (micro_offset_bps z_in 2.5/z_out 0) SR -0.36, 12 fills, gross negative. bl.linear on weighted_depth_imbalance: SR -5.2 (1900 turns/h, fees 112k bps/h) - never submit linear on book signals.
  Book-skew moves (~1 bp) << fee (5 bps) + spread. Imbalance is a maker/timing signal; a taker strategy needs a >10 bp move predictor, which we lack. Trade flow too weak to try.
- Session 10 (market_making, STRATEGIES; strategies/mm10.py): decorator is `bl.market_making(instrument=...)`; quote(bid/ask offsets, None withdraws side). Maker fee 2 bps >> 0.85 bps tick, so every always-on quote loses (train SR -2 to -3, adverse 10s ~ -1 bp/unit).
  micro_side_select (withdraw toxic side by micro_offset ±0.3bp) SR -2.1; micro_lean_quote (join behind, lean by micro) SR -2.8; both not submitted.

Trial 27 flow30_slow_threshold (flow_persist_30s z_in 2/z_out 0): 18 fills, SR -0.07, gross +3.6 bps/h, not released. Taker edge is fee-bound; nothing beats zero. Recommend phase_done.
- Session 12 (market_making, STRATEGIES; strategies/mm12.py): agree_safe_side (wdi>0.35 & micro>0.3 safe-side quote) 73 fills, SR -0.44 train (adverse 10s -18bp?), not submitted. Trial 28 wdi_improve_extreme (wdi |.7|, size .5) SR -0.09, 6 fills, not released.
  Same pattern: more fills => fee (2bp) loses; fewer => ~0. No maker edge at fee 2. Recommend phase_done.
- Session 13 (speed, STRATEGIES; strategies/s13.py): trial 29 deep_imbalance_slow (deep_imbalance z_in 3/z_out .5, slow 60s-IC signal) 216 fills, gross -2.4 bps/h, SR -1.95 (fees 1083 bps/h), not released. Slow book signal doesn't help: gross ~0, fee-bound. Recommend phase_done.
- Session 14 (market_making, STRATEGIES; strategies/mm14.py): trial 30 deep_calm_quotes (safe-side quote 3 ticks behind touch when |wdi|>0.3, size .5) 18 fills, SR -0.105, gross -2.6 bps/h (spread "captured" +6.6 but inventory loss -29), not released. Deep quotes get picked off by sweeps (adverse). No maker edge at fee 2; recommend phase_done.

# DATA: tardis-binance-solusdt-perp-mm-2026-10-01

File `train.parquet`, sha256 `d0f1a67e3dfb153d`.
Clock: receive. Grid: 100ms steps, 432,000 points, 2026-10-01 00:00:00+00:00 to 2026-10-01 11:59:59.900000+00:00; warm-up 5min.

Scoring windows (warm-up removed):
- train [2026-10-01T00:05:00+00:00, 2026-10-01T12:00:00+00:00)
- val [2026-10-01T12:05:00+00:00, 2026-10-01T18:00:00+00:00)
- test [2026-10-01T18:05:00+00:00, 2026-10-01T23:59:59.900000+00:00)

## A thinned file

For every grid point g this file keeps the last book row at or before each of the stamps g, g + 50 ms, and drops the rest; the judge reads the book only there, so the panel, the fills and every forward return are what the raw file would give. Each kept book row carries `n`, the raw updates it stands for, so `cum_book` counts them all. Trades are summed per side between the panel's reads: one row per side and step at the stamp of that side's last trade, `qty` the side's total, `price` its volume-weighted price and `n` its number of trades. Volumes, notionals, trade counts and the side of the last trade are exact at every grid point; `price` and `qty` of the last trade are the step's per-side VWAP and total, not one print.

Reads at other stamps would see the kept row before them, so the judge leaves out the horizons and offsets the file cannot serve: decay horizons under one step that do not end on a kept stamp, and markout offsets likewise. Lead-lag inside one step is in the raw-file section, where it was measured before thinning.

## Streams

Gaps are between distinct timestamps; `stale_share` is the share of grid points whose latest event is older than one grid step. On this thinned file they describe the kept rows, not the market.

| stream | instrument | rows | duplicate_rows | events_per_s | median_gap_ms | p90_gap_ms | stale_share |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| book | SOLUSDT_PERP | 585,147 | 0 | 13.55 | 58.25 | 136.9 | 0.1345 |
| funding | SOLUSDT_PERP | 2 | 0 | 4.63e-05 | 2.88e+07 | 2.88e+07 | 1 |
| trades | SOLUSDT_PERP | 855,440 | 477,675 | 8.745 | 0.007 | 389.6 | 0.7599 |

The cross-stream lags and trade stamps of the raw file are in the raw-file section at the end; on the kept rows they would measure the thinning.

## The touch stream

The fill engine reads every top-of-book row of SOLUSDT_PERP from the touch file `train.touch.parquet` (4,105,119 rows here), in ticks of 0.01, and each trade at its own stamp; features never see it. Over this workspace's rows:

| measure | value |
|---|---|
| mid, median; tick | 117.965; 0.01 = 0.848 bps |
| spread one tick wide, share of time; two ticks | 99.99%; 0.01% |
| book rows (a second); distinct stamps | 4,105,119 (95); 3,096,429 |
| trades (a second) | 855,440 (19.8) |
| displayed at the touch, median bid; ask; bid in USD | 744.4; 689.5; 87,807 |
| falls of the best bid; traded out; pulled; partly | 8,949; 84.0%; 0.1%; 15.8% |
| median time between changes of the best bid price | 639.3 ms |
| rows at an unchanged bid price; of them with the bid's size changed | 4,087,082; 2,065,134 |

A fall of the best bid is traded out when the sells at the old price from 100 ms before its last row to the fall reach the size it showed, pulled when there were none, and partly each otherwise. Where most levels are traded out, a quote at the back of the touch fills when the level is swept; where many are pulled, the two queue models disagree most.

## Caveats

- Rows with identical timestamps resolve by file order, last wins.
- Which instruments are in the file, and why, is for the user to own.
- Receive clock: a lead of one stream over another can be market lead or feed delay; these numbers cannot tell them apart.

## Splits

- train: 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00 to 2026-10-01T12:00:00+00:00; this workspace holds these 1,440,589 rows (sha256 `d0f1a67e3dfb153d`)
- validation: 2026-10-01T12:05:00+00:00 to 2026-10-01T18:00:00+00:00; in the vault, scored through the Ladder only
- test: 2026-10-01T18:05:00+00:00 to 2026-10-01T23:59:59.900000+00:00; in the vault, scored once at the end
- embargo of 5min before validation and before test

## The raw files behind tardis-binance-solusdt-perp-mm-2026-10-01.parquet

Built by `blinded demo mm` from the Tardis free day 2026-10-01: the SOLUSDT_PERP USD-M perpetual (`binance-futures` `book_ticker`, `trades`, `book_snapshot_5` and `derivative_ticker` of SOLUSDT), every stamp Tardis's `local_timestamp`, the recorder's receive clock, the first 24 hours of the day. Tardis files have no checksum; their sizes and SHA-256 are these:

| file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---|
| binance-futures_book_ticker_2026-10-01_SOLUSDT.csv.gz | 95,939,166 | `17b1334b010bed81` |
| binance-futures_trades_2026-10-01_SOLUSDT.csv.gz | 14,394,837 | `d45cdff8c386ff50` |
| binance-futures_book_snapshot_5_2026-10-01_SOLUSDT.csv.gz | 48,512,609 | `e6018fb7cb8d8e8e` |
| binance-futures_derivative_ticker_2026-10-01_SOLUSDT.csv.gz | 1,791,425 | `c957bd3d28b36522` |

The data file keeps the book rows a read at a grid point or at a grid point plus 50 ms returns (a 100 ms grid from midnight), each with `n`, the raw rows it stands for, and levels 1 to 4 of the snapshot as-of its stamp; every trade at its own stamp with the touch as received; and the day's funding settlements, each the rate of the last `derivative_ticker` row that names it, available 1 s after it. The touch file `tardis-binance-solusdt-perp-mm-2026-10-01.touch.parquet` holds every two-sided `book_ticker` row, prices in ticks of 0.01; only the fill engine reads it. Tick 0.01 and lot 0.01 from Binance's exchangeInfo (read 19 Oct 2026); every book price is a whole number of ticks.
